newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas in refinery talks with Maraven.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas in refinery talks with Maraven.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp's TransAmerican Refining said on Monday that it is in talks with Maraven SA about its possible participation in the TARC refinery in South Louisiana.

TransAmerican said the talks with the unit of Petroleos de Venezuela SA have taken place to analyze the possibility for the supply of cred and a processing agreement for the 200,000 barrels per day refinery.
TransAmerican said it was continuing discussions with other interested parties concerning an additional investment in the refinery.
TransAmerican Refining said Petroleos de Venezuela is one of the world's larges exporters of crude oil and a dominant producer of heavy, sour crude.

The refinery, located near New Orleans, is undergoing a cpaital improvement program set for completion in early 1997 that will allow it to process 200,000 barrels per day of mixed feedstock, including heavy, sour crude, TransAmerican said.
